journal.title: Safe Space Journaling
journal.subtitle: Encrypted, private thought-unloading to quiet your mind before sleep.
journal.contentPlaceholder: Write freely. There is no right way to feel...
journal.empty: No journal entries saved yet. Writing for 5 minutes can clear mental clutter.
journal.loadError: We could not load your entries. Please try again.
journal.saveError: We could not save this entry. Nothing was sent in readable form. Please try again.
journal.deleteError: We could not delete this entry. Please try again.
journal.decryptError: These entries could not be decrypted with this passphrase.
journal.crisisTitle: It sounds like things are very heavy right now
journal.crisisBody: Your entry was saved on this device only. You do not have to carry this alone. Please reach out to one of these free, confidential helplines, available 24/7:

prompts.release: What is one expectation you can release tonight?
prompts.peace: Write about a small moment of peace you experienced today.
prompts.friend: If your closest friend felt this exam pressure, what would you say to them?
prompts.sleep: What is one boundary you can set to protect your sleep this week?
prompts.proud: What is one thing you handled today that you are quietly proud of?
prompts.support: Who or what helped you feel supported this week, even a little?

vault.loadError: We could not check your vault. Please check your connection and try again.
vault.setupIntro: Your journal and CBT notes are encrypted in your browser with a passphrase only you know. MindSahaay, your university and your counsellors can never read them.
vault.warningTitle: Important: no one can reset this for you
vault.warning: If you lose both your passphrase and your recovery code, your encrypted entries are lost for good. We cannot recover them, because we never see your passphrase.
vault.passphraseHint: At least 8 characters. A short sentence you will remember works well.
vault.mismatch: The two passphrases do not match.
vault.recoveryIntro: This code is the only way back in if you forget your passphrase. Write it down or save it somewhere safe and private.
vault.savedCheckbox: I have saved my recovery code and I understand that losing both it and my passphrase means losing my entries.
vault.createError: We could not create your vault. Please try again.
vault.unlockIntro: Enter your passphrase to read and write encrypted entries. It stays in this tab's memory and is cleared when you lock or close it.
vault.wrongPassphrase: That passphrase is not correct. Please try again.
vault.wrongRecovery: That recovery code is not correct.
vault.badRecoveryFormat: That code is not in the format XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.
vault.recoveredTitle: Vault unlocked with your recovery code
vault.recoveredNote: Your passphrase was recovered. Show it once and write it down.
